name: 先手斗气
description: 对满生命值的敌军造成的伤害提高50%。
skillCode: var holder = context.rulePiece; var victim = context.sourcePiece; var attacker = context.targetPiece; if (!holder || !attacker || attacker.instanceId !== holder.instanceId || !victim || victim.currentHp <= 0 || victim.currentHp !== victim.maxHp || flow.query.pieces({ originId: holder.instanceId, relation: "enemy" }).indexOf(victim.instanceId) === -1) return { success: false, message: '' }; var damage = Number(context.damage || 0); if (!(damage > 0)) return { success: false, message: '' }; flow.event.modify('damage', damage * 1.5); return { success: true, message: holder.name + '触发先手斗气，伤害提高50%' };
